title: States of Matter
ques: Water can exist in three states. Name what we call water when it is a solid, when it is a liquid, and when it is a gas.

answer.content:
Water as a solid is called **Ice**.
Water as a liquid is called **Water**.
Water as a gas is called **Water Vapor** (or steam).

explanation: This exercise familiarizes students with the three common states of matter using a relatable substance.

title: State Changes
ques: What happens to a solid piece of butter if you leave it in a hot frying pan? What is this state change called?

answer.content: The solid butter will turn into a liquid. This state change is called **melting**.

explanation: This demonstrates a physical change of state caused by the addition of heat.

title: Particle Theory Basics
ques: Imagine the tiny particles inside a solid rock and inside a balloon filled with gas. In which one are the particles packed tightly together, and in which one are they spread far apart?

answer.content: In the **solid rock**, the particles are packed very tightly together, so it keeps its shape. In the **balloon filled with gas**, the particles are spread very far apart and move around freely.

explanation: This introduces the microscopic particle behavior that defines macroscopic states of matter.
